name: Earthen Templar
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus.  With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside.

Find a way to summon and destroy an Earthen Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
narrative.objectives: Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Good job, adventurer.  Here's your next assignment.
narrative.requestItemsText: Is your task done yet, adventurer?
